story.originalTitle: The FIA extends its deepest condolences to the family and loved ones of Alan Jones. A Formula 1 World Champion and true motor sport legend, his legacy...
story.summaryEn:
The FIA extends its deepest condolences to the family and loved ones of Alan Jones.
A Formula 1 World Champion and true motor sport legend, his legacy and contribution to our sport will never be forgotten. Our thoughts are with his family and friends.
detailZh:
国际汽联向艾伦·琼斯家族及亲友致以最深切的哀悼。
艾伦·琼斯是 Formula 1 世界冠军，真正的赛车运动传奇，他的遗产和对我们运动所做的贡献将永远被铭记。我们的思念与他的家人和朋友们同在。
detailEn:
